At least 8 identical ordinary
symbols anywhere on the whole
board win. Symbols do not need
to touch or share a row. All
positions belong to one
board-wide count for each symbol
type.
The table shows coins for ONE
qualifying symbol type at the
current total bet, using its
full-board count; all payout factors
are already included. Pay each
type once, then add the awards.
WILD counts only as its own type
and does not complete other types
. SCATTER and BONUS have
separate rules.

全盘任意位置累计出现至少8个相同普
通符号即可中奖，不要求相邻或同行
。每种符号在整块棋盘上统一计数，
不划分区域。
表格按同一种符号在全盘的总数，显
示当前总投注下该类型实际获得的金
币，已包含赔付系数。每种达标类型
只付一次，再把各类型奖金相加。百
搭单独计数，不补足其他符号的数量
。散布和奖励符号另按对应规则。

全盤任意位置累計出現至少8個相同普
通符號即可中獎，不要求相鄰或同列
。每種符號在整塊棋盤上統一計數，
不劃分區域。
表格按同一種符號在全盤的總數，顯
示目前總投注下該類型實際獲得的金
幣，已包含賠付係數。每種達標類型
只付一次，再把各類型獎金相加。百
搭單獨計數，不補足其他符號的數量
。散布和獎勵符號另按對應規則。

盤面全体の任意の場所に同じ通常絵
柄が合計8個以上あれば当選です。隣
接や同じ段である必要はありません
。絵柄ごとに盤面全体で一つの個数
として数えます。
表は盤面全体の同一シンボル数に応
じて、現在の総ベットでその種類に
支払われるコイン数です。配当係数
は計算済みです。条件を満たす各種
類に1回払い、合算します。ワイルド
は独立した種類で、他の種類の個数
を補いません。スキャッターとボー
ナスは別ルールです。

전체 보드의 어느 위치든 같은 일반 기호가
총 8개 이상이면 당첨입니다. 서로 붙어 있
거나 같은 행일 필요가 없습니다. 기호 종
류마다 전체 보드를 하나의 영역으로 세어
판정합니다.
표는 보드 전체의 같은 기호 수에 따라 현
재 총 베팅에서 해당 기호 종류에 지급되는
코인입니다. 배당 계수는 이미 반영되어 있
습니다. 조건을 만족하는 종류마다 한 번
지급하여 더합니다. 와일드는 별도 종류이
며 다른 기호 수를 채우지 않습니다. 스캐
터와 보너스는 별도 규칙을 따릅니다.

Match at least 3 identical symbols
on a shown payline, starting on
the leftmost reel without a gap.
Each line pays only its highest
valid result. WILD substitutes for
ordinary symbols, never SCATTER
or BONUS.
All 10 lines are active. The table
shows coins for ONE winning line
at the current total bet; all bet
splits and payout factors are
already included. Add different
winning lines. Only the best result
on each line pays; shorter prefixes
are not paid again.

Each spin opens 2–4 positions on
each of 5 reels. Match the same
symbol on at least 3 consecutive
reels from the leftmost reel, in any
open row. Closed positions never
participate. WILD substitutes for
ordinary symbols.
The table shows approximate
coins per winning combination at
the current bet, already using the
fixed 1,024-way basis. Multiply the
unrounded value by winning
combinations, then round each
symbol’s longest-run total to
whole coins. ≈ values are
shortened references, not exact
calculation inputs. Reel heights
stay fixed during this spin’s bonus
; all-WILD ways pay only as WILD.

Two independent 3 × 3 boards
spin together. Each uses 5 shown
paylines. Three identical symbols
from the leftmost reel win on a line
; a line never crosses from one
board into the other. WILD
substitutes for ordinary symbols.
The total bet is split equally
between the two boards. The table
already shows coins for ONE
winning line on ONE board,
including the split and payout
factor. Pay only the best result on
each line, then add both boards’
wins. Do not divide the displayed
award again. SCATTER and
BONUS follow separate rules.
